details:
I was in a public instance of the Avatar Dynamics hub, along with around 14 other players. And my game crashed out of nowhere.
The graphics were frozen for a good 5 seconds then I got a blackscreen with the SteamVR "Waiting" screen. And finally about 10 seconds later the game completely crashed.
Before the crash was complete, I could still move my head and hear the audio turn around me, and I could open my menu and hear the laser hover sounds.
There was no crash handler window after the game closed.
Here is the output log (verbose logging was enabled)
https://output-logs.are-really.cool/94Etuub.txt (this domain is safe, just a custom link to a private uploader on https://whats-th.is)
To be quite honest, I have dealt with a similar crash bug on Live for almost a year now, which showed itself when I had synchronization lock exceptions "Object has not been locked by this thread" At the time, my assumptions were that my AMD FX CPU was running into deadlocks because of L2 cache latency between cores. So I upgraded my entire computer, and those exceptions have been entirely gone since. (There aren't any in this post's output log either) I know it may not be related, but the crash behavior was identical, so I find it important to bring up.
title: [1181] Random crash
